integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, a perfectly static medium-wide shot preserves the exact framing, lighting, costume and courtyard layout of <Picture 1>: the young woman in flowing wide-sleeved white hanfu, long straight black hair partially pinned with a simple dark hair ornament, stands three-quarter turned toward the camera beneath blooming pink cherry branches; a lit stone lantern sits on each side, a dark traditional wooden hall stands behind her, and colorful low flowers border the gravel path. The camera never cuts. She slowly turns her face toward the lens, parts her lips and begins to sing, her mouth opening and closing naturally in perfect sync with the heard singing, her head nodding gently on the beat, her pale hands rising slightly from the wide sleeves in a soft graceful gesture as if phrasing the melody, while the white silk sleeves and long hem sway faintly in a light breeze. Pink cherry petals drift slowly downward through the frame, a small bird flutters quickly across the upper-right corner behind the blossoms, and the flowering branches sway almost imperceptibly. Her expression remains serene, eyes softly lowering then lifting toward the camera between phrases.

overall_soundscape: A soft spring breeze rustles the cherry branches and the silk fabric of her hanfu; petals drift down with near-silent movement, and a brief distant bird call sounds as the small bird crosses the frame.
